## Summary of findings

**Accession O15247** is the human **Chloride intracellular channel protein 2**. Every independent cross-reference in the record points to the same gene:

| Source | Identifier | Resolved gene |
|---|---|---|
| HGNC | HGNC:2063 | **CLIC2** (aliases: XAP121, CLCNL2) |
| NCBI Gene | 1193 | **CLIC2** (X chromosome) |
| Ensembl | ENSG00000155962 | **CLIC2** |
| Protein name | — | Chloride intracellular channel protein 2 (alt: XAP121) |

**However**, the `geneName` field in the UniProt record literally reads **"IDH3A"** — which is inconsistent with all of the above. The true IDH3A is a separate entry (**P50213**, isocitrate dehydrogenase [NAD] subunit alpha, mitochondrial, HGNC:5384). The cited HGNC ID (2063) belongs to CLIC2, confirming the gene-name string is a data-entry error in the UniProt record rather than a genuine IDH3A assignment.

Given the protein identity and all cross-references agree on CLIC2, the gene symbol should be **CLIC2**.
